Based on the visual analysis of the time series plot, the data exhibits a stable pattern with minor fluctuations around 0 mm for the majority of the duration (from index 0 to approximately 480). However, starting around index 480-500, there is a distinct and sustained downward trend (a drop) that continues until about index 620, where the values stabilize at a new, lower level (around -35 mm). This significant deviation from the baseline behavior constitutes an anomaly.

The range of this anomalous event covers the start of the decline through the stabilization period.

[[490, 620]]
